beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Counting on adds, and counting back takes away. Start at eight. Count on three. What number do you land on?

do.text: Start at 8. Count on 3. What number do you land on?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Eight, nine, ten. I land on ten.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eight was where you started. You made only two hops.

do.text: The start is not a hop.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Stand on eight. Say a number each time you land.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Eight is where I stand. Nine, ten, eleven. I land on eleven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Each hop on adds one. Eight plus three equals eleven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Start at fourteen. Count back four. What number do you land on?

do.text: Start at 14. Count back 4. What number do you land on?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: I stand on fourteen. Thirteen, twelve, eleven, ten.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Four hops back take away four. Fourteen minus four equals ten.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Count on from thirteen: fourteen, fifteen, sixteen. How many were added to thirteen?

do.text: Count on from 13: 14, 15, 16. How many were added to 13?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Fourteen, fifteen, sixteen. One, two, three. Three were added to thirteen.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Each number said is one hop. Thirteen plus three equals sixteen.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The number you land on tells where. The hops tell how many.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Each number you say is one hop. Hop on to add. Hop back to take away.

do.text: Each number you say is one hop.
